crossRefs.note: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple…
crossRefs.keyword: draws down the thread with the fingers of the left hand

crossRefs.note: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
crossRefs.keyword: draws down the thread with the fingers of the left hand

translations.web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
translations.bsb: She stretches out her hands to the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.
translations.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
translations.asv: She layeth her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold the spindle.
